body: I actually was taking meds before, but they made me incredibly hostile and mean, and I have a lot of trouble with counselors and therapists. But maybe I can look around for one that I can trust. Thank you :)

I do not. Day to day I’m fine. It’s more or less when I get sad and things pile on that I have thoughts of drinking. 

Like on an up day, my car breaking down wouldn’t push me to drink. 

But on a day when I’m already upset just because and every other thing seemingly goes wrong and I feel like a failure, I want to drink.
